_readme: THE single source of the quick-chat ids, their D-pad groups, our default texts and the drawable character set.
Read by gen_chat_tables.py (C header for the console image, the image's own-text table, the lobby array, the doc table),
by the host tests, by the lobby server's tests and by docs/design/QUICK_CHAT.md.  Nothing else hard-codes an id or a text.
How an id is formed (slippi-ssbm-c Scenes/CSS/Chat/Chat.c UpdateChatWindow: chatCommand = (groupId << 4) + chatInput; the
same 16 values are listed in vendor/ishiiruka Source/Core/Core/Slippi/SlippiPremadeText.h CHAT_MSG_* and are the only ones
SlippiNetplay.cpp ReadChatMessageFromPacket accepts):
first D-pad press opens a group, second D-pad press picks the message in that group;
id = (pad bit of the group << 4) | pad bit of the message, GameCube D-pad bits: left 0x1, right 0x2, down 0x4, up 0x8.
0x10 is not a menu entry: it is the automatic 'this player has chat off' notice (SlippiPremadeText.h CHAT_MSG_CHAT_DISABLED).
Table index = group position * 4 + message position, both in menu order up, left, right, down
(slippi-ssbm-c Core/Notifications/Chat/Text.c GetGroupIndex / GetChatText: chatMessages[(groupIndex * 4) + (index - 1)]).
Texts: our own wording, 1-25 characters (25 = MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH, vendor/ishiiruka EXI_DeviceSlippi.h).  Each keeps the
MEANING of Slippi's default text for the same id (column 'meaning', our paraphrase), so a Slippi peer that shows its own
default for an id says roughly the same thing.  Slippi's own default strings are not copied here.
charset: what our console can draw with Melee's own text code.  ascii_direct = the characters Melee's ASCII-to-SIS encoder
maps itself (HSD_SisLib_803A67EC, vendor/melee src/sysdolphin/baselib/hsd_3A64.c:137-219); sjis = punctuation the console
passes as a Shift-JIS pair (the encoder copies unknown bytes as a pair, every pair below is in Melee's glyph table
lbl_8040C8C0, checked against the retail DOL by gen_chat_tables.py check-font; same full-width forms as Slippi's
ConvertNarrowSpecialSHIFTJIS, vendor/ishiiruka Source/Core/Common/StringUtil.cpp:384-397).  Left out on purpose:
backslash and backtick (no glyph in Melee's font) and the double quote (drawable, but it would need JSON escaping, which
would make a ticket's size depend on the text; without it 16 strings always fit the lobby's 1024-byte message limit).

notice_disabled.meaning: the other player has quick chat disabled
